summary: Frontend UI verification of I-showed-up Meals module changes: (1) Compare Items chart, (2) Compare Items sidebar shortcut, (3) Stock Master sub-categories CRUD + item assignment. All three areas work as specified. Cleanup performed (TESTPulses sub-category deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: MealMastersTab.jsx is ~1140 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold. Consider splitting InlineEdit/InlineNum/InlineRate/InlineDate/InlineUnit helpers and NutritionEditorModal into separate files for maintainability.
Sub-category delete flow relies on window.confirm — consistent with existing pattern but not accessible; long-term switch to a shadcn AlertDialog would improve UX.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleanly deleted sub-category 'TESTPulses' under 'fruits' category. Temporarily assigned Apple to it, then removed via delete-detach. Pantry left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (a) Sidebar link 'Compare Items' (href /admin/meals-report?tab=compare) works and opens meal-compare-tab. (b) Compare tab shows 3 chart lines (recharts .recharts-line count=3): Purchases (blue), Issues (orange), Net dashed (green). Legend text: 'IssuesNetPurchases' - contains 'Issues' NOT 'Consumption'. Three summary cards render: compare-total-purchases ('Purchased 951.6 units'), compare-total-consumption ('Issued 113.0 units' - label is 'Issued', not 'Consumption'), compare-total-net ('Net (buy − issue) +838.6 units'). Amount toggle switches all cards to ₹ with +/− prefix, e.g. '+₹63,369.72'. (c) Stock Master: Add sub-category button (masters-subcat-add-<catKey>) opens inline input; save creates sub-header (masters-subcat-<catKey>-<key>). Item-level dropdown masters-item-subcat-<itemId> appears when subcats exist for that category, moves item under sub-header on select. Deleting the sub-cat detaches items — since delete happened when it was the ONLY subcat, items rendered without headers (expected: 'Ungrouped' header only appears when other subcats remain). Assigned item persisted in tree after subcat deletion.
